title: Capability routing index and cross-domain harness model
summary: Superseded historical record. The routing index was the hand-maintained predecessor of this registry: a pointer document routing to where each Bouch domain's harness facts live (Battlebuild/asset work, REAPER/audio, UK legal, UK due diligence, linear media). Do not route from it — it drifted, and the document itself is now marked HISTORICAL / SUPERSEDED. Kept because it still carries the frozen cross-domain harness model and /prime contract V1, whose portable successors are bouch-agent-core's own references.

source.note: Deliberately not published: the index's pointers enumerate private checkouts and unpublished projects. The harness model and prime contract are frozen at the cited tag; the routing index was added after it, and was marked superseded by this registry on 2026-09-17 after three of its statements were found stale (a missing sessinspect command, linear-media state, and the Godot MCP addon described as in-repo when it is vendored upstream).
